comment: Easy class, but for a half-credit, feels like a lot of work. Her instructions on homeworks are pretty vague which makes you have to spend a lot more time either revising or reading through the assignment directions. Easy class if you put in a bit of time  and get on her good side. Be sure to practice before you present because she will know.
I enjoyed her course! If you are engaged in class, well-prepared for group presentations, and follow the guidelines for assignments, an A is not difficult to achieve.

She was a very nice lady but gives super annoying assignments and bases the curriculum off of a book she wrote. She is super weirdly specific in what she wants and some of it honestly doesn't make sense it kind of pisses you off sometimes. Get ready to be haunted by "Action headings".

She is a great professor who really wants to help you to do good in her class. Don't be afraid to ask how to do the homework. She would literally help you finish her homework and even assign you to a group with your friends if you act really good at the beginning of each semester's class.

Put in the effort and you will get an easy A because of how the grades work. Groups are divided randomly so be active with your group and just pray for luck. In class participation matters and the work is just mostly busy work. Not the best but a good choice to get half a credit out of the way.

Conn uses the mastery system so it is hard not to do well in her class. She gives out a lot of busy work and most of it is tedious and not enjoyable. Group projects and some of the papers are very particular and she lays out what she wants from you, but her grading is a bit unclear. Overall, she's very sweet but likes everything her way.

Very nice professor, though sometimes the work for presentations could seem a bit overwhelming. Grades on a mastery system, so you get multiple attempts on homework and stuff, which should guarantee you at least a B in the class depending on your presentation grades

Very nice lady, but grading is very unclear and she's kinda tough when grading the presentations. Minimal work most of the time except during presentations. Pray that your partner/group will actually do work.
